source_contract.source: unchanged calibrated quadratic two-momentum action and exact native mass frames
source_contract.source_reference_and_clock: the exact parent quadratic source, quasiparticle vacuum, dual charge/color reference and declared GeV-conjugate evolution parameter

instrument_formula: K_(a,y) = sum_(g in a) A_y(phi(E_g)) P_g; K_vac=P_vac, K_many=P_many, then compose with each original probe
phase_formula: phi(E)=1/4+(E-1)/R_a; R_a is the least power of two >= max(1,4 max_g(E_g-1))

adaptive_pointer.complete_word_identity: product_j K_(b_j|r_j)=2^-n sum_(k=0)^(2^n-1) exp(-2pi i k y/2^n) U^k
adaptive_pointer.known_qubit_recycling: after readout b, controlled X^b returns the pointer to blank while keeping b in the original classical record

uniform_confidence.failure_bound_proof: |A_y|²<=1/(4 d²), d=circular lattice distance; two tails sum <=(1/K²+1/K)/2
